reviews.title: Cute and functional
reviews.comment: Super pleased with the quality and the aethetics. Attachments are snug but not too tight, flexibility of the cables makes it easy to get them to set cleanly under the side panel while the cable combs allow nice, smooth curves in the visible part of the case. Zero issues with stable electrical transmission. Super cute.
reviews.author: Toni DiNardo

reviews.title: Great cable extensions
reviews.comment: This is the 3rd set I have purchased for myself and family members. I love the texture of the cables and look of them. They work great with no problems. I would highly recommend this brand if you were in the market for extensions.
reviews.author: Dave Bishop

reviews.title: look phenomenal
reviews.comment: These are the best extensions i’ve used they are extremely durable considering the amount of times i’ve bent them. They are very bendable considering how thick they are. They were so easy to put it and make my build look 10 times better
reviews.author: Youssef

reviews.title: phenomenal product!
reviews.comment: Great extensions for the price, phenomenal quality and tensile strength.
reviews.author: Ronny Acosta

reviews.title: Stylish braided extensions for PC builds
reviews.comment: These sleeved extensions include combs for neat cable management and fit standard PSU/GPU connections. The braiding is flexible yet durable, and colors add style to custom PCs. Not a replacement for original PSU cables, just extensions. Great for improving aesthetics.
reviews.author: aNoN
